TEAM-431.description:
Original requirements
- Existing expiry boundary stays unchanged.
- Rotate returns a new refresh token.
- Reusing an old refresh token revokes its token family.
- Follow-up: per-device selective revoke UI remains unimplemented.

Acceptance criteria
- At expiration time the token is rejected.
- A valid refresh token rotates twice successfully.
- Reusing the prior token blocks the entire family.

Reference: https://example.invalid/spec/431
Peer note (Mina): retain expiry API contract.

## This branch work
- Implemented refresh-token rotation and token-family revocation after reuse.
- Preserved expiry boundary behavior.
- Integrated the old remote task branch peer commit 10eab6b6d493cda21c05611a3bad77553e7e5360; audit event helper remains present.
- Validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed 6 tests, including peer audit and shared develop behavior.
- Remaining: per-device selective revoke UI is unimplemented; original requirements remain authoritative.
